description: This script generates registration functions for partial interfaces in the Blink rendering engine, based on IDL files. It processes IDL file lists, extracts interface names, and creates C++ code to initialize these interfaces.

methods.name: parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options for input files and output destination.

methods.name: extract_meta_data
methods.description: Extracts interface names from IDL files if they meet criteria.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the script execution: parsing options, extracting metadata, generating code, and writing output.
